title: Corralling AI Risks with Grassroots Contracts
abstract: arXiv:2611.06374v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI's inflection point is a fountain of alarming risks. Digital platforms in particular are vulnerable to three major AI risks, as those in control of global platforms cede control to AI, of the algorithms, of membership and of content: (1) AI control of global platforms, social and economic, used by the majority of humanity, resulting in the majority of humanity becoming vulnerable to AI control. (2) Unaccountable AI agents operating anonymously on social and economic digital platforms, side-by-side with humans, possibly masquerading as humans, serving unknown masters with unknown goals, operating under unknown restraints without accountability or culpability. translated_title: 以草根契约圈控人工智能风险
translated_abstract: 人工智能的转折点带来了大量令人担忧的风险。数字平台尤其容易受到三大AI风险的影响，因为全球平台的控制者正在将控制权让渡给AI——包括算法控制权、成员控制权和内容控制权：(1) AI控制被人类大多数人所使用的全球社会与经济平台，导致大多数人类容易受到AI的操控。(2) 无法问责的AI智能体在社交与经济数字平台上与人类并肩匿名运行，可能伪装成人类，为身份不明的主人服务，追求未知的目标，在未知的约束下运行，缺乏问责机制和责任追究。(3) 由匿名AI生成、无法归因的深度伪造内容，人们无法将其与真实内容区分开来，其制作者则逃避问责和追责。在此，我们提出用草根契约来圈控这些AI风险，草根契约是一种……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出以“草根契约”这一数字化契约机制，来圈控AI操控全球平台、匿名AI智能体逃避追责以及无法归因的深度伪造内容这三大AI风险。
en_tdlr: Proposes "grassroots contracts," a digital incarnation of contractual agreements, to corral three major AI risks: AI control of global platforms, unaccountable anonymous AI agents, and unattributed deepfakes.
